name: key_facts_present
rule: After lowercasing and removing thousands separators, the answer contains every required fact (one alternative per group is enough) and none of the forbidden facts.

name: refusal_phrase
rule: The answer contains the phrase insufficient knowledge and none of the forbidden facts. It must not guess.

name: conflict_stated
rule: GR1 where the required facts name both sources and include a conflict word, so the answer reports that the sources disagree instead of choosing one. A human reads every result at first, because a conflict word is only a proxy.

name: duplicate_cited_once
rule: Exactly one of the cited files belongs to the duplicated document (D12). Citing the file and its copy fails.

name: citations_valid
rule: At least one cited file is an answer-key source, and no cited file is outside the answer-key sources. A file from another node or an old version counts as outside.
